question.question_text: What event immediately follows the camera wearer using a screwdriver to secure screws?

answer_options.text: Connects wires to the system board
Handles a circuit and a hard disk drive
Adjusts the position of the motherboard
Examines chips before fixing them onto the motherboard

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer uses a screwdriver to remove screws from the laptop. This action is followed by the camera wearer removing the hard drive from the laptop and placing it on the table. The next action after using the screwdriver to secure screws is the removal of the hard drive.
